verdict.rationale: Mercury Books supports several built-in rule-like automations: categorization rules via Mercury Command, automatic GL coding, multi-layered bill approval rules, duplicate-bill detection, and recurring invoices — all of which trigger actions on specific events (docs-4, docs-12, docs-13, docs-14, supp-command). However, these are fixed, domain-specific automations rather than a general-purpose 'define any rule for any event/action' framework, and Mercury itself cautions that the system is a 'better starting point,' not full autopilot (supp-honest-scope). missing for 10: a general user-configurable rule/trigger builder spanning arbitrary events and actions, independent verification of rule flexibility, and evidence beyond categorization/approval/invoicing domains.
